description: This header defines the API and data structures for sampling hashtables and collecting runtime statistics within the Abseil C++ library, including classes, functions, and macros related to hashtable sampling and profiling.

classes.name: HashtablezInfo
classes.description: Stores runtime profiling information about a sampled hashtable, including capacity, size, probe lengths, and stack trace.

classes.name: HashtablezInfoHandle
classes.description: RAII handle managing registration and deregistration of sampling info, with different implementations depending on compile-time sampling configuration.

methods.name: RecordRehashSlow
methods.description: Records a slow rehash event with total probe length.

methods.name: RecordReservationSlow
methods.description: Records a reservation event with target capacity.

methods.name: RecordClearedReservationSlow
methods.description: Records that a reservation has been cleared.

methods.name: RecordStorageChangedSlow
methods.description: Records a change in storage size and capacity.

methods.name: RecordInsertSlow
methods.description: Records an insert operation with hash and distance from desired position.

methods.name: Sample
methods.description: Returns an RAII handle for sampling, possibly creating a new sample based on thread-local state.

methods.name: GlobalHashtablezSampler
methods.description: Returns the singleton global sampler instance.

methods.name: SetHashtablezConfigListener
methods.description: Sets a callback for configuration changes.

methods.name: SetHashtablezEnabledInternal
methods.description: Internal function to set sampling state.

methods.name: SetHashtablezSampleParameterInternal
methods.description: Internal function to set sampling rate.

methods.name: GetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of samples to keep.

methods.name: SetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of samples to keep.

methods.name: SetHashtablezMaxSamplesInternal
methods.description: Internal function to set max samples.
